question: Can either minimal invertible repair of claim 1533 descend naturally and surjectively to the protected five-role physical coefficient matrix?

strictQuotientTheorem.sourceProperty: both repaired source Dirac operators are invertible
strictQuotientTheorem.kernelProperty: QD_source=D_target Q makes ker(Q) D_source-invariant; finite-dimensional invertibility implies the induced quotient operator is invertible
strictQuotientTheorem.targetProperty: a relation-even grading-odd operator acts separately on each relation sheet, but the target sheet has chiral dimensions 3 and 2

matrixMultiplicityRepair.targetCompression: retain PN, one linear combination of the two IN copies, IP, one linear combination of the two TP copies, and SP; discard the complementary multiplicity directions and TU
matrixMultiplicityRepair.naturalityObstruction: choosing C^2 to C functionals for the IN and TP multiplicity spaces selects coupling rays; there is no nonzero U(2)-invariant linear functional
matrixMultiplicityRepair.status: compression SAT only after choosing rays by hand; full descent UNSAT

newSectorRepair.targetCompression: retain the five chain sectors PN,IN,IP,TP,SP and discard TU,SI,NU plus J partners
newSectorRepair.status: canonical coordinate compression exists but is singular and cannot be upgraded by a legal Schur complement

coefficientInsertionAudit.why: the source support has no self-sector edge; compression of the retained chain cannot create diagonal coefficients
coefficientInsertionAudit.interpretation: manual A,D insertion recovers the claimed texture, but D is indispensable for invertibility and is not derived by either descent

forbiddenSupportAudit.reasonNoLegalSchurTest: the three-dimensional auxiliary block on each relation sheet is grading odd and singular
forbiddenSupportAudit.regularizationCost: making that block invertible requires a new relation-mixing or grading-even/self term outside the admissible support

decision.manualCoefficientCompletion: SAT but inserts A,D and a multiplicity ray
decision.exactMissingDatum: a non-linear or non-quotient correspondence functor that supplies the two effective diagonal coefficients and canonically selects the common multiplicity ray while forbidding L--N support
decision.strongestConclusion: neither minimal rank repair naturally descends to the invertible protected five-role operator; the desired matrix is not a linear quotient or legal Schur complement of the repaired finite Dirac data

boundary: The no-go covers complex-linear surjective Dirac-intertwining quotients and relation-compatible coordinate compressions of the two explicit minimum repairs. It does not exclude a new non-linear, energy-dependent, derived-category, Jordan or path-algebra correspondence, but such a rule is precisely additional programme input.
